summary: The Phase 3 security re-review passes at 79f86404b with one nonblocking Major finding and no blocker. F1 is closed: readTable rejects an id that fails ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ with exit 2 before any stdout, and the select step is the only writer of the matrix. F2 is closed: ci.yml line 24 holds permissions: contents: read, and no job widens it. F5 is closed: the runbook states the sales-advantage exception, and its step list matches cloudbuild-traffic.yaml. The six new Test roots add no secret, no production network call, and no new environment value. A2 is not applicable and A6 has no hit. F6 stays open: ci.yml pull_request paths omit scripts/**, and no workflow runs the scripts/ci/__tests__ suite.
nonblocking_findings: F6 [Major] review-b: .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 8-22 list the pull_request paths and omit scripts/**. A pull request that changes only scripts/ci/apps.json or scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs starts no ci.yml run. No workflow runs the selector tests either: a grep over .github/workflows for node --test, scripts/ci/__tests__, ci-remediation, and ci-workflow finds no match. The tests CI-R1 to CI-R3 of scripts/ci/__tests__/ci-remediation.test.mjs therefore never run in CI. The selector decides which app a push builds and which app deploys. Rationale: the adversarial tests of the deploy gate must run on every change to the gate. The impact is bounded: the push trigger holds no path filter, so a master push runs ci.yml before a deploy, and the deploy still needs Daniel's word. A scripts/** entry in the paths list and one test step close the gap.
evidence: Provenance: phase_base_sha 25d774e08a0f9bef8074fb6f88bde439d1a72066 resolves. role_base_sha and audited_head_sha are 79f86404b4ac46ff2bca1c8f12d8468b24033eed. HEAD is 998c6dc74, and git diff --stat 79f86404b..HEAD lists one measure plan file only.

F1 closed: scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs defines SAFE_ID = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/ and readTable fails on a row whose id does not match, before main writes stdout. scripts/ci/__tests__/ci-remediation.test.mjs CI-R2 (line 254) runs three unsafe ids (x;rm -rf /, --help, a b) and asserts a refusal. The ci.yml select step (lines 47-57) is the only writer of the matrix, and it writes JSON.stringify output.

F2 closed: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 24 holds permissions: contents: read at workflow level. grep -n 'permissions' .github/workflows/ci.yml returns line 24 only, so no job declares its own block. scripts/ci/__tests__/ci-remediation.test.mjs CI-R3 (line 296) asserts the workflow map equals {contents: read} and that no job widens it.

F5 closed: docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md lines 15-17 state the sales-advantage exception to the tag rule. Lines 129-159 name the same steps and the same order as apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml. The file moves traffic with --to-revisions to the revision that capture-company-candidate records, and the runbook says the same.
F3 withdrawn: the owner declined it. The five new uses lines follow the existing ci.yml style (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v4).
F4 withdrawn: the PM puts the sales source binding into Phase 4 as one task, so it is out of P3 scope.

Six new Test roots: architecture-enforcement, knowledge-space-practice, mastery-runtime-compat, scripts, session-service, and worker. No root reads a secret. session-service reads REDIS_URL only when it is set, and ci.yml sets no REDIS_URL. session-service tests listen on 127.0.0.1 port 0. worker health tests bind 127.0.0.1 port 0. scripts/generateArticle.test.js injects a fake client. mastery-runtime-compat spawns local node processes. architecture-enforcement uses ARCHITECTURE_TEST_TMPDIR. knowledge-space-practice reads repository files. No root adds an env value to ci.yml.
A2: the P3 diff over the track paths holds no draft, published, consent, or anonymization token (git diff 57bb8376c..79f86404b with that grep exits 1). No test flips a named subject to published.
A6: measure/tracks.md line 79 says Phase 2 in review remediation. It claims no resolved security state, so the registry does not overstate the implementation.
Limits: this role ran no workflow, called no gcloud, read no secret, and ran no test suite.
